ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a green feather-like plant structure, with a clear central stalk/rachis, many small leaflets arranged on both sides, and the whole gradually narrowing toward the tip. There are letter labels and brackets beside it pointing to different parts. Reasoning: This structure composed of a central axis and many pinnae on both sides is the leaf of a fern; the leaf of a fern is called a frond. Therefore, what the diagram shows is a fern frond.
